arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'conan/cli/commands/remove.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('conan.cli.commands.remove')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)

import os, tempfile
from conan.test.assets.genconanfile import GenConanfile
from conan.test.utils.tools import TestClient
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
pl1 = os.path.join(tmp, 'pkglist.json')
pl2 = os.path.join(tmp, 'pkglist2.json')
pl3 = os.path.join(tmp, 'pkglist3.json')
c = TestClient()
c.save({'conanfile.py': GenConanfile('pkg', '0.1')})
c.run('export .')
c.run('list *#*:* --format=json', redirect_stdout=pl1)
assert 'pkg/0.1' in open(pl1).read()
print("get_hit", True)
c.run(f'remove --list={pl1} -c')
assert "No binaries to remove for 'pkg/0.1" in c.out
print("equivalence", True)
c.run('list * --format=json', redirect_stdout=pl2)
c.run(f'remove --list={pl2} -c')
print("isolation", True)
c.run('export .')
c.run('list *#*:* --format=json', redirect_stdout=pl3)
c.run(f'remove --list={pl3} -c')
assert "No binaries to remove for 'pkg/0.1" in c.out
print("invalidate", True)
c.run('remove pkg/0.1 -c')
from conan.api.model import RecipeReference
assert c.cache.get_recipe_revisions_references(RecipeReference('pkg', '0.1')) == []
print("removed", True)
c.run('export .')
c.run('list *#*:* --format=json', redirect_stdout=pl1)
assert 'pkg/0.1' in open(pl1).read()
print("recompute", True)

PYREPLAY
